summary: Formats a register/state value into a 16-byte local buffer via sub_49C6D0, reading the value from a display context pointer stored at this+0x10 (this[4]) dereferenced 84 bytes deep, then renders the text to the HUD at screen position (4, 0) via sub_553070, whose return value becomes this function's return. No guards; both calls always execute.

local_names.this: owner instance holding the display resource context pointer
local_names.v3: 16-byte stack buffer receiving the formatted text

operations.description: Call sub_49C6D0((int)v3, 15) to format the register/state value string into the 16-byte local buffer with length bound 15

Load the dword at this+0x10 (this[4]) as a base pointer, then read the dword 84 bytes into it; the extractor records this composite access as a this+0x64 read, and the loaded value becomes the text argument for the render call
Call sub_553070(v3, 4, 0, value) to render the formatted text to the HUD at screen position (4, 0)
Reached from SteeringWheelAnimation (0x0049D070) as the register/steering value text dispatch

unresolved: The deterministic extractor lists a global read at 0x007CE234 (unk_7CE234, labelled DriverAppearanceFlag in the fill) that is not visible in the raw source; its role here is unknown.
The field extractor records a this+0x64 read while the raw source shows this[4]+84 (84 = 0x54 past the this+0x10 pointer value); the exact relationship between these two renderings is unclear.
The meanings of the sub_553070 position arguments (4, 0), of the 15 length bound, and of the 84-byte value offset are unknown.
